program.section_heading: BACHELOR DEGREE: RESPIRATORY THERAPY Bachelor of Science Degree (BS)
outcomes: Leadership - Students will be able to apply the essential leadership and management skills necessary to lead effectively within healthcare organizations, ensuring quality patient care, team collaboration, and sustainable department operations.

Research - Students will be able to demonstrate the ability to critically analyze respiratory therapy literature, design and conduct research studies, apply ethical research practices, evaluate and interpret data, and effectively communicate findings.
Communication – Students will be able to apply interpersonal and professional communication skills that result in effective interaction with others, both orally and in writing.
Knowledge - Students will be able to achieve knowledge and understanding of issues outside of the traditional respiratory care area to fully participate in multidisciplinary rounding.

Professional Attributes – Students will be able to demonstrate professional integrity, respect diverse perspectives, and apply ethical principles to ensure high-quality patient care and compliance with healthcare standards.
